subject: Pricing & model-mix follow-up / token volumes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & model-mix follow-up / token volumes

Hi Sam — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call + next steps so we have alignment.

Call highlights: 
- Use cases: in-product assistant (chat), semantic search + recommendations (embeddings), and on-the-fly ranking for candidate recommendations (rerank).
- Key success metrics: latency under 300ms for chat p99, embedding recall > 90%, and rerank throughput of ~150 reqs/min during peak.

We covered pricing a bit — to get a concrete quote I need the following so we can model unit economics and recommend a model mix: 
1) Estimated monthly token volume by workload: chat vs embeddings vs rerank (if you can give rough percentages or absolute tokens/month that’s ideal).
2) Target budget range (monthly or per-1M token target $/1M tokens) — helps us propose model/quantization mixes.
3) Any constraints: max latency target, on-prem/VPC requirement, or data residency.

From our side, I’ll pull a pricing snapshot and a provisional SOW for a 3-month pilot once we have volumes. Attaching a short pricing worksheet that shows example unit economics at different model mixes.

Next steps: 
- You: send high-level monthly token estimates and target $/1M tokens (or monthly budget).
- Me: send revised quote + SOW draft by EOD Tuesday based on the numbers.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-pricing-quote.xlsx (pricing worksheet, sample model mixes)

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liza Park <liza.park@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model-mix follow-up / token volumes

Thanks Marissa — good call. Below are the rough numbers we promised. These are top-level and can be refined.

Estimated monthly volumes (tokens/month):
- Chat (assistant for product): 45,000,000 tokens/month
- Embeddings (search + recommendations): 7,500,000 tokens/month
- Rerank (small re-ranking requests): 2,500,000 tokens/month
- Total: 55,000,000 tokens/month

Model mix preference:
- For chat, we’d like to prioritize accuracy for multi-turn conversations; open to an LLM that balances cost/quality (1–2 variants for canary).
- Embeddings: want high-quality semantic embeddings (we use them for recall-sensitive search).
- Rerank: small inputs but higher QPS during business hours.

Budget: target is roughly $250 / 1M tokens (company average benchmark). We have flexibility +/-20% for pilot if the quality is demonstrably better.

Constraints:
- No on-prem requirement for pilot; hosted API ok.
- Need SOC2 evidence and a short security questionnaire (Liza will send the standard form).

Let me know if you want these broken into daily request patterns; we can send hourly QPS for a typical weekday.

—Sam
Sam Turner
Head of ML Platforms, Acme Analytics
sam.turner@acme-analytics.com | +1 617-555-0133

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing & model-mix follow-up / token volumes (Acme) — token volumes + budget

Looping you both on Acme — they provided volumes and a target $/1M tokens ($250 target). High level: 55M tokens/month total (chat 45M, embeddings 7.5M, rerank 2.5M).

Requesting: 
- Rishi: can you run a quick unit-econ calc for a 3-model mix (chat: gpt-like LLM small/medium variants, embeddings: high-dim SBERT-like, rerank: optimized rerank model) and propose 2 pricing tiers (pilot and committed)? Use target $/1M tokens = $250 as one baseline and committed discount stack (x% at $/1M thresholds).
- Vivek: please prepare a 1-page SOW draft that covers a 3-month pilot, success metrics, and trial support levels. Attach the SOC2 summary and security questionnaire link (they requested it).

I’ll turn their hourly QPS request into a latency/throughput plan once we pick a baseline model. Also flagging potential need for embedding quantization advice to hit the $/1M targets while preserving recall.

Thanks — aiming to have internal draft by EOD so I can send their quote + SOW by 17:30 PT.

Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Liza Park <liza.park@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model-mix follow-up / token volumes

Sam / Liza — thanks for the numbers and context. Quick summary + proposed next steps: 

1) Volumes received: chat 45M, embeddings 7.5M, rerank 2.5M (55M total).
2) Budget target: $250 / 1M tokens for the pilot (we’ll show committed pricing tiers that improve unit economics).
3) Proposed model mix (first-pass recommendation):
   - Chat: Redwood-chat-medium (primary) + Redwood-chat-small (canary) — ~82% of tokens (approx 45M)
   - Embeddings: Redwood-embed-high-dim — ~14% of tokens (approx 7.5M)
   - Rerank: Redwood-rerank-small (optimized for throughput) — ~4% of tokens (approx 2.5M)

4) Unit economics ask: we’ll model 2 scenarios for you —
   A) Pilot (no commit): on-demand pricing that targets ~$250 / 1M tokens; we’ll include quantized embedding options to lower cost while preserving recall.
   B) Committed (3–12 month): tiered $/1M tokens that drops with volume commitments; example: $220 / 1M at 3-mo commit equivalent, $180 / 1M at 12-mo. Exact numbers pending Rishi's calc.

5) Next steps & timeline:
   - Today: we’ll send a draft SOW + pricing worksheet (attached) and a link to the SOC2 summary + security questionnaire.
   - You: Liza to send the security questionnaire; Sam to confirm whether the $250/1M is an absolute cap for pilot or flexible.
   - Target: sign pilot SOW and start a 30-day pilot by mid-April.

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (pilot SOW), redwood-pricing-quote.xlsx (sample unit economics).

If that all sounds good I’ll generate a short mutual action plan and set a follow-up for Wed to lock down the SOW.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
